name: Cron
description: Scheduled, unattended Oino runs: /cron (list, show, runs, run, stop, enable, disable, pause, resume, status, add, edit, remove) with job-id completions, agent tools (cron_list, cron_add, cron_update, cron_remove, cron_run), scheduler settings in the hub and the bundled cron skill. Jobs live as files under ~/.oino/cron/jobs (written directly); firing needs the Unipi host's embedded scheduler (unipi-host) — under a plain oino TUI jobs are managed but nothing fires.
